meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
Here are some of the best, highly-rated face washes for oily skin in India that are priced **under ₹500**. They feature ingredients like **Salicylic Acid**, **Niacinamide**, or **Green Tea** to help control excess oil, unclog pores, and prevent breakouts without stripping your skin's natural moisture.[sixamglow.com](https://sixamglow.com/blogs/skincare/budget-friendly-buys-top-7-foaming-cleansers-for-oily-skin-in-india-under-500#:~:text=Before%20you%20buy%20oily%20skin,oil%20production%20and%20soothes%20inflammation.)

---

### Top Recommendations Under ₹500

| Product Name | Key Active Ingredients | Estimated Price (INR) | Best For |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser** | 2% Salicylic Acid, LHA, Zinc | ~₹299 | Deep pore cleansing, controlling excess sebum, and preventing pimples. |
| **Plum Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash** | Green Tea, Glycolic Acid | ~₹320 - ₹380 | Controlling oil, fighting acne, and gentle chemical exfoliation. |
| **Deconstruct Salicylic Acid & Niacinamide Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide | ~₹263 - ₹299 | Dual-action oil control and reducing blemishes/inflammation. |
| **Pilgrim Tea Tree Purifying Foaming Face Wash** | Tea Tree, Salicylic Acid | ~₹175 | Refreshing foaming action, antibacterial action, and daily oil control. |
| **Dot & Key Cica Calming Blemish Clearing Gel Face Wash** | Salicylic Acid, Green Tea, Cica | ~₹214 - ₹249 | Soothing sensitive, oily, or acne-prone skin while managing shine. |

---

### What to Look for in an Oily Skin Face Wash:

* **Key Ingredients:** * **Salicylic Acid (BHA):** Penetrates deep into pores to dissolve trapped sebum and dead skin cells, making it great for blackheads and breakouts.[www.flipkart.com](https://www.flipkart.com/q/facewash-for-oily-skin#:~:text=For%20Daily%20Use%3A%20Search%20for,the%20pores%20to%20dissolve%20oil.)
  *   * **Niacinamide:** Helps regulate sebum production, calms redness, and strengthens the skin barrier.
  * **Tea Tree / Green Tea:** Natural ingredients with antibacterial and antioxidant properties that help keep acne-prone oily skin clear.[sixamglow.com](https://sixamglow.com/blogs/skincare/budget-friendly-buys-top-7-foaming-cleansers-for-oily-skin-in-india-under-500#:~:text=For%20those%20prone%20to%20breakouts,4)
* **Texture:** Opt for **gel-based** or **foaming** cleansers rather than heavy, creamy formulas.[www.flipkart.com](https://www.flipkart.com/q/facewash-for-oily-skin#:~:text=Gel-based%20Face%20Washes%3A%20The,spreads%20smoothly%20across%20the%20face.) They leave the skin feeling fresh and clean without a heavy residue.[sixamglow.com](https://sixamglow.com/blogs/skincare/budget-friendly-buys-top-7-foaming-cleansers-for-oily-skin-in-india-under-500#:~:text=Lightweight%20Texture%3A%20Unlike%20heavy%20cream,Key%20Ingredients%20to%20Look%20For)

*Note: Prices may vary slightly depending on ongoing discounts on platforms like Nykaa, Amazon, Flipkart, or brand websites.*
